primary_objective: Net expectancy per settled overlapping-ticket campaign, not win rate alone
promotion_requirements: Replay actual changed entry timing, current dynamic exits and capacity; retrospective ticket subsets are not a strategy backtest
Bid/ask execution data, fees and slippage assumptions declared; missing tick coverage reported
Chronological training/calibration/test; purge overlapping label horizons and group correlated tickets
Freeze the chosen hypothesis before a genuinely new shadow period; record every attempted variant
Positive net expectancy must not depend on one day or one campaign; uncertainty and extra-cost stress reported
Reject variants with negative net expectancy or unconfirmed data quality; no forced live trades to create labels
Separate approval and validation before any execution change; no live or real-money activation by this file

experiments.hypothesis: Small apparent gains disappear under additional execution costs
experiments.test: Add hypothetical USD 0.10/0.25/0.50 per closed ticket to actual settled campaigns; do not call this a fill simulation
experiments.next_step: Collect richer execution cost and rejected-opportunity evidence; do not loosen risk to recover losses

experiments.hypothesis: Three same-colour candles can end in rejection or excessive entry extension
experiments.test: One fixed candidate filter at a time, chosen only in an earlier calibration segment, then faithful replay and new shadow data
experiments.forbidden: No threshold optimized on the final test or on the thirteen current trades

experiments.hypothesis: Trend and range conditions need different interpretations without redundant confirmations
experiments.test: Stratify existing outcomes by recorded M5 regime and session; compare one regime gate with the unchanged baseline
experiments.forbidden: No additional ADX/Hurst/EMA stack or London-only restriction merely because a post recommends it

experiments.hypothesis: Later additions on an extended move dilute the campaign expectancy
experiments.test: Measure marginal outcomes of ranks 2 through 5 and causal ATR/price spacing; replay any changed spacing with fixed lots
experiments.forbidden: No martingale, averaging down, burst orders or larger lots

experiments.hypothesis: S30 may refine timing but amplify cost/noise exposure
experiments.test: Compare point-in-time S30 context and future executable outcomes while retaining M1/M5 authority
experiments.forbidden: No S30 execution, synthetic gap fills or pretending quote imbalance is centralized traded volume

experiments.hypothesis: Automatic retraining and small win-rate improvements can select noise
experiments.test: Record model/data versions, all trials, purged chronological validation and calibration; inspect negative results
experiments.forbidden: No pretrained web pickle/EX4/EX5 execution, API keys shared with third parties or automatic weekly parameter application
